## Restart capsule

`loomctl pause` sends repository path/name, branch, HEAD, changed-file summary, diff stat, explicit failed command, and exact next step. Loom cannot execute host commands. `loomctl resume` retrieves the newest matching capsule.

Select the same **Loom personal intake** Header Auth credential on both webhooks before publishing. State retains only 25 capsules; no source, diff contents, environment, command history, or credentials are collected.
